exact_findings: IDEV2 DTSUM=max(0,TAV-TBASE); pre-anthesis DVS increment DTSUM/TSUMEA; post-anthesis DTSUM/TSUMAM
DVS is capped at 2; LAI is AFGEN(LAITB,DVS)
optional WRT is AFGEN(WROOTTB,DVS) and GRRT/DRRT derive from the accepted WRT change
Pinned fixed.f90 declares TBASE as SAVE, reads it only in IDEV2, yet update_cropfixed computes DTSUM=max(0,TAV-TBASE) for both modes.
When WRT is prescribed by WROOTTB, source sets GRRT=max(0,WRT-WRT_OLD), GRRTPOT=GRRT and DRRT=abs(min(0,WRT-WRT_OLD)).

ownership: One shared transactional fixed-crop state for DVS/TSUM/LAI and optional crop-owned root biomass; no duplicate owner per IDEV selector.

owner_binding.root_growth: actual and potential gross root-growth carriers are identical for fixed prescribed root biomass; they can feed the shared SWRD2 depth owner without a potential biomass shadow.
